description: Young companies worth knowing, grouped by the theme they bet on, with where each was first spotted and its sources.

startups.name: Warp Sciences
startups.pitch: US chemistry lab for drug research where chemists wearing cameras and sensor gloves train robots to make and test molecules.
startups.round: $215M led by Lightspeed, with IVP, Premji Invest and Lux Capital

startups.name: Maxinsights
startups.pitch: First-person video of people doing everyday tasks, sold as training data for robot foundation models.
startups.round: $30M seed led by Peak XV

startups.name: Enact Intelligence
startups.pitch: Robot actuators that sense force and touch, so robot hands can do dexterous work.
startups.round: $30M pre-seed led by redalpine, Notion Capital and firstminute capital

themes.summary: Startups are paying people to wear cameras, sensor gloves and touch-sensing hardware so robots can learn real hands-on work, from lab chemistry to household chores. The bet: recorded human skill, not more internet text, is what physical AI is short of.
themes.title: Robots that learn hands-on work from people

startups.name: Solink
startups.pitch: Turns the security cameras already in restaurants, stores and warehouses into AI-read operating data on staffing, service and loss.
startups.round: More than $100M growth round led by Vertu Capital

startups.name: Bites
startups.pitch: AI-made 90-second training videos sent to frontline staff over WhatsApp, SMS or Teams, in 150+ languages; reports 161% net revenue retention.
startups.round: $40M Series A led by PeakSpan Capital

startups.name: Foundry Robotics
startups.pitch: Builds and runs AI-driven robotic assembly factories, so defense and industrial hardware makers can go from design to production in weeks without their own lines.
startups.round: $100M Series A led by Marlinspike Partners, with Khosla Ventures, Wing VC and SE Ventures

startups.name: Circuit Mind
startups.pitch: AI for circuit-board design; its new tool sends a swarm of agents to check schematics against datasheets before a prototype is built.
startups.round: $25M: $18.5M Series A led by Norwest plus an earlier seed led by Third Prime

startups.name: Bedrock Robotics
startups.pitch: Self-driving kit retrofitted onto existing excavators, now digging on paid US construction sites.
startups.round: $600M Series C at a $4.1B post-money valuation, co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital

startups.name: Formic
startups.pitch: Rents robots to US factories for one monthly fee, in 100+ facilities, and is moving to general-purpose robots built with Physical Intelligence.
startups.round: $50M: Series B led by Mercato Partners plus debt from S2G Investments (split undisclosed)

startups.name: Tractian
startups.pitch: Sensors plus AI that monitor industrial machines, diagnose failures and recommend fixes for factories.
startups.round: $130M Series D at a $1.4B valuation, led by Sapphire Ventures and co-led by M&G's Catalyst

startups.name: ASI
startups.pitch: AI that forecasts and runs operations for airspace, power grids and military logistics.
startups.round: $325M Series C at a $3B valuation, led by Spark Capital

startups.name: Arda
startups.pitch: AI agent that turns design changes into factory assembly instructions, for defense and industrial manufacturers.
startups.round: $230M total raised (seed and Series A) at a $1.5B valuation, led by Altimeter, Accel and Khosla Ventures

startups.name: Eka Robotics
startups.pitch: Force-aware robot manipulation model paired with a low-cost gripper.
startups.round: $150M Series A at a $1.45B valuation, led by a16z and F-Prime

startups.name: Reliable Robotics
startups.pitch: Autonomous flight system fitted to existing aircraft, working toward FAA certification.
startups.round: $90M equity led by Nimble Partners (plus $25M debt), a Series D extension at a valuation above $1B

startups.name: Neolix
startups.pitch: Level-4 autonomous delivery vans running in more than 300 cities.
startups.round: Nearly $400M Series E co-led by Boyu Capital and a national-level fund

startups.name: Watchtower Labs
startups.pitch: AI decision tools that help military planners model what happens next and weigh options, starting with logistics.
startups.round: $35M seed co-led by Shield Capital and Conviction, with Founders Fund

themes.summary: The biggest rounds of the day went to AI that runs the physical world: airspace and grid planning, factory engineering, robot hands, autonomous aircraft and delivery vans. Four of them were valued at $1B or more.
themes.title: AI that runs physical operations

startups.name: Fractile
startups.pitch: London chip startup building chips and systems that run large AI models faster, including long-context workloads.
startups.round: About £540M (~$721M) Series C, per Companies House filings; The Cap Table counts £577M

startups.name: Powerlattice
startups.pitch: Power-delivery chiplet that sits inside the processor package and, the company says, cuts AI chip energy use by more than half.
startups.round: $86M raised toward a $111M round (SEC Form D; investors not named)

startups.name: Runware
startups.pitch: Factory-built modular AI data-center pods, shipped ready to install and brought online within 48 hours; plans an assembly line making 30 MW of capacity a day by 2028.
startups.round: $50M Series A

startups.name: FuriosaAI
startups.pitch: Korean AI chipmaker selling RNGD inference accelerators as an energy-efficient alternative to Nvidia in data centers.
startups.round: $620M Series D at about $2.9B post-money

startups.name: General Compute
startups.pitch: Inference cloud built on SambaNova, Cerebras and Positron chips instead of Nvidia GPUs, anchored by a $100M-ARR customer deal.
startups.round: $100M Series A at an $800M post-money valuation, co-led by Blackbird and Abstract

startups.name: Simplismart
startups.pitch: Bengaluru inference software that lets companies run AI models on fewer GPUs.
startups.round: $14M Series B led by Dallas Venture Capital, with Nvidia

startups.name: Gimlet Labs
startups.pitch: Inference cloud for agent workloads that splits each job across GPUs and other AI chips to run models faster and cheaper.
startups.round: $300M Series B at a $3B valuation, led by Andreessen Horowitz (Sept 2026)

startups.name: Flapping Airplanes
startups.pitch: AI lab working on training large models with far less data, built on its own GPU megakernel framework.
startups.round: $1B Series A co-led by Index and Lux, reportedly at a $6B valuation

startups.name: Recursive
startups.pitch: Self-improving AI lab; released Flint, an open 40B mixture-of-experts coding model that runs on a laptop and that it says its automated research system largely built.
startups.round: $650M at a $4.65B valuation on leaving stealth in May 2026 (no new round with the Flint launch)

startups.name: Tenstorrent
startups.pitch: RISC-V AI chips and Galaxy servers for serving open-weight models on-prem, from a single card to superclusters; also licenses its CPU and AI cores to chip designers.
startups.round: $1.5B Series E at a $6.2B valuation, led by Trace Capital and Innovation X

startups.name: doubleAI
startups.pitch: Maxwell, a code execution model that rewrites running programs for their exact hardware, formally proves each change is safe and bills a share of the compute it saves.
startups.round: $200M Series A co-led by Lightspeed and Bessemer

startups.name: Approaching.AI
startups.pitch: Beijing inference company (Qujing Technology, makers of KTransformers) running 'token factories' that serve open models cheaply on Chinese chips.
startups.round: More than RMB 1.3B (about $195M) Series B, co-led by Zhejiang Finance Capital, Xiaoshan Capital and ICBC Investment

themes.summary: The largest checks this week went to companies that make AI cheaper to train and run: inference chips, chiplets that cut wasted power, factory-built data-center pods, inference clouds, and labs that train models on far less data. Fractile's Series C and Powerlattice's $86M landed on the day Intel had its worst day ever.
themes.title: Getting more out of AI compute

startups.name: Utopai Studios
startups.pitch: AI film and TV studio with about 20 projects in the works, including three features it plans to release in about 3,000 North American theaters next year.
startups.round: $60M at a $1B valuation

startups.name: Wonder Studios
startups.pitch: AI-native studio making films and series with human directors; co-made the AI-generated Odyssey pilot that Grok Imagine released on Oct 23.
startups.round: $12M seed led by Atomico (Oct 2025)

startups.name: Higgsfield
startups.pitch: AI video and image generation for creators, brands, agencies and studios; says it passed $1B in annualized revenue.
startups.round: $400M Series B at a $5.4B valuation led by DST Global, extended in October with Nvidia and TCV (amount undisclosed)

startups.name: Alta
startups.pitch: AI stylist app that builds outfits from your own closet on a personal avatar, and powers styling inside apps like Rent the Runway.
startups.round: $20M Series A led by Forerunner

themes.summary: Apps and studios that generate video, images, films and outfits are turning into real businesses with revenue and brand deals behind them; AI-made features and series are now headed for theaters and streaming.
themes.title: AI that makes video, films and styles for consumers

startups.name: Wabi
startups.pitch: Shared personal AI agent for couples, families and friends: group spaces where the agent builds mini-apps to plan, book and decide together.
startups.round: $55M at a $1.25B valuation, led by IVP

startups.name: SuperMe
startups.pitch: Network of AI profiles built from real experts' knowledge; ask a question and it opens a group chat with the best-matched experts' AI profiles.
startups.round: $20M led by Forerunner, with Greylock

startups.name: Rocker
startups.pitch: Work assistant for busy people at large companies that keeps a living model of projects and decisions and links every colleague's assistant.
startups.round: $12.85M led by Greycroft, with Anthropic and Menlo Ventures' Anthology Fund

startups.name: Nous
startups.pitch: UK household agent that switches energy, broadband and insurance deals, cancels subscriptions and handles family admin; about 250,000 households signed up.
startups.round: $17M led by Heartcore Capital with Mosaic Ventures

startups.name: Instinct
startups.pitch: Personal AI agent you text or call that books, buys, cancels and follows up on your behalf, with its own email address.
startups.round: $1B Series C at a $10B valuation

startups.name: Nirva
startups.pitch: AI pendant that listens only to its wearer and turns the day into a journal, mood patterns and advice.
startups.round: $25M pre-Series A, bringing total funding to $33M (backers include Lightspeed and South Park Commons)

startups.name: Town
startups.pitch: Gives every employee an AI assistant that works across their email, docs, calendar and work apps, and hands work to teammates' assistants.
startups.round: $108M Series B at a $1B valuation, co-led by Forerunner and Menlo Ventures

startups.name: Tolan
startups.pitch: Consumer AI companion that remembers you and helps with everyday tasks; 250K+ active users.
startups.round: $30M led by Union Square Ventures, with Khosla Ventures

themes.summary: Assistants are moving from waiting for prompts to acting on their own: at work, an assistant per person that coordinates with teammates' assistants; at home, an agent you simply text, or a persistent companion that remembers you and helps with everyday life.
themes.title: Assistants that act on their own, for teams and for people

startups.name: Dulo
startups.pitch: Sebastian Thrun and Adrian Aoun's startup building foundation models for hardware design, aiming at 'manufacturing at lightspeed'.
startups.round: $130M seed

startups.name: Dream
startups.pitch: Built world models trained on 100M+ sq ft of US permit data that design and engineer buildings and estimate their cost, aimed at replacing AutoCAD and Revit work.
startups.round: $17M seed led by Andreessen Horowitz

startups.name: Phonic
startups.pitch: Speech-to-speech voice model (Phonic-1) built for agents that look things up and book while the caller is still talking; ranked #1 on Artificial Analysis' speech-to-speech index.
startups.round: $27.5M Series A led by First Round

startups.name: Machenta
startups.pitch: Imperial College spinout with a robot foundation model trained entirely in simulation that learns a new task from one demonstration.
startups.round: $40M seed co-led by Creandum and Union Square Ventures

startups.name: Atlas Bio
startups.pitch: Foundation model trained on about 2M human RNA readouts that simulates patient responses before Phase II drug trials.
startups.round: $12.5M total: $10M seed led by Creandum plus a $2.5M pre-seed

startups.name: Pathos AI
startups.pitch: Cancer-drug developer whose Foundry agentic AI platform mines about 200 petabytes of oncology data to pick and run drug programs.
startups.round: $237M Series E at about a $3B post-money valuation, led by Bristol Myers Squibb

startups.name: Dream Labs
startups.pitch: Dream-1, a robot foundation model trained on human video that controls robots it has never seen, sold through a pay-per-hour API and fine-tuning service.
startups.round: $90M seed led by B Capital with Kindred Ventures

startups.name: Coherence Neuro
startups.pitch: AI-driven brain implant that reads glioblastoma tumor signals and responds to them, aiming at cancer therapy that adapts to live data.
startups.round: $45M seed backed by Founders Fund and the OpenAI Startup Fund

startups.name: Electric Plant Company
startups.pitch: Plant sensors plus Bombadil, a foundation model that reads plants' electrical signals.
startups.round: $11.2M seed

themes.summary: Startups train their own models on robot motion, hardware designs, building permits, live speech, tumor activity and oncology data, then sell them as an API or build products on top. Seed rounds here now reach $130M.
themes.title: Foundation models for robots, hardware, buildings, voice and new drugs

startups.name: Paradev
startups.pitch: Code editor (formerly Superset) for running many coding agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree; used at one in eight Fortune 500 companies.
startups.round: $11.5M seed led by Union Square Ventures

startups.name: Daytona
startups.pitch: Agent Cloud: instant sandboxes and full computers that AI agents spin up, use and keep.
startups.round: $60M Series B at a $1B valuation, led by FirstMark Growth

startups.name: Modal
startups.pitch: Serverless AI compute: inference, training and isolated sandboxes for coding agents and RL rollouts.
startups.round: $750M Series D at a $15.75B valuation, led by Accel

startups.name: herdr
startups.pitch: Open-source runtime that coding-agent sessions run on.

startups.name: Uvi
startups.pitch: Shared context layer so enterprise agents query company knowledge once instead of re-searching Slack, Jira and code.
startups.round: $7.5M seed led by CT Innovations

themes.summary: Developers now run many agents for hours at a time, and each one needs its own lasting, isolated computer, a runtime to keep it alive and company context it does not have to gather again. Modal and Daytona both raised this week to give agents their own computers.
themes.title: Computers, runtimes and context for fleets of agents

startups.name: Upwind
startups.pitch: Runtime cloud security platform extending into securing AI workloads and agents; says revenue quadrupled in 2026.
startups.round: $400M Series C at a $3.8B valuation, led by Bessemer Venture Partners

startups.name: Plato
startups.pitch: Simulated workplaces (support, finance, HR, healthcare admin) where AI labs train and test agents on real jobs before they touch live systems.
startups.round: $16M Series A led by Nava Ventures, with Gradient Ventures and Mustafa Suleyman

startups.name: Hex
startups.pitch: Analytics platform rebuilt from scratch as agent-first (Hex 4.0), with context, controls and human verification of agent work; 2,500+ customers.
startups.round: $100M at a $1.2B valuation, led by Peak XV and 137 Ventures

startups.name: Infisical
startups.pitch: Secrets, certificate and access management; its Agent Vault proxy injects credentials so AI agents never see them.
startups.round: $40M Series B at a $600M valuation, led by Elad Gil with Y Combinator

startups.name: Modelyo
startups.pitch: Confidential cloud that lets governments, banks and other regulated organizations run cloud services, AI and agents without exposing their data or encryption keys.
startups.round: About $17M led by OlivTree, with Seth Merrin and David Phelps

startups.name: Ultra Security
startups.pitch: Runtime security for AI agents: watches and blocks risky agent-to-tool actions, with guardrails and audit logs.
startups.round: $10M seed

startups.name: Blacksmith
startups.pitch: CI cloud that builds and tests code, including the surge of AI-written code; 10,000+ companies, weekly CI jobs up from 5M to 90M+ this year.
startups.round: $66M Series C at a $1B valuation, led by Sequoia

startups.name: Greptile
startups.pitch: AI code review and testing that teams use as one independent check on changes from all their coding agents.
startups.round: $50M Series B at a $750M valuation, led by Menlo Ventures

startups.name: Harmonic Security
startups.pitch: Monitors and controls how employees use AI tools and agentic workflows, for security teams.
startups.round: $50M Series B led by Crosspoint Capital Partners

startups.name: Opsin
startups.pitch: Finds, monitors and contains risky AI-agent behavior across enterprise AI tools.
startups.round: $21M led by SYN Ventures and Race Capital

startups.name: Armadin
startups.pitch: Autonomous security testing: agent swarms that find and validate exploitable attack paths for enterprises.
startups.round: $255.5M Series B co-led by a16z and Accel

startups.name: Rein
startups.pitch: Security platform for agentic AI that sees beyond the prompt.
startups.round: $25M Series A

startups.name: Harbor
startups.pitch: Measures, mitigates and insures the risks of AI agents for banks, insurers and other regulated firms.
startups.round: $10M seed led by Base10, Abstract and 8VC

themes.summary: AI now writes code faster than teams can build, test and check it, and companies treat agent risk as something to verify, watch, contain and insure, from someone other than the model vendor. Money is going to CI capacity and independent review of agent-written code, and to runtime oversight of the agents already at work.
themes.title: Checking, securing and insuring agents

startups.name: Serval
startups.pitch: AI service desk where staff describe a workflow in plain language and agents build and run it, starting with IT and moving into HR, finance and legal; pitched as a ServiceNow replacement.
startups.round: $150M Series C at a $3B valuation, led by Sequoia

startups.name: Reflex
startups.pitch: Uses AI agents to build, deploy and maintain custom business apps for manufacturers and logistics firms, so they stop renting generic software.
startups.round: $14M Series A led by Standard Capital

startups.name: Collective
startups.pitch: AI-native finance back office for one-person businesses: entity setup, bookkeeping, payroll, invoicing, tax filing and insurance in one place.
startups.round: $40M Series B led by General Catalyst, QED and Gradient, plus a $60M growth facility ($100M total)

startups.name: Fragment
startups.pitch: Agents that investigate and resolve purchasing and payment exceptions for large manufacturers and distributors, priced by work completed rather than seats.
startups.round: $56M total: Series A led by 8VC and seed co-led by General Catalyst and A*

startups.name: Hyphenate
startups.pitch: Self-learning finance agents (formerly Maximor) that run routine CFO-office work on top of existing ERP and banking systems.
startups.round: $45M Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners, with B Capital

startups.name: Avante
startups.pitch: AI agents for corporate benefits teams: checking claims against contracts and handling renewals, with 70+ customers.
startups.round: $30M Series A led by Frist Cressey Ventures

startups.name: CapitalOS
startups.pitch: Lets vertical software platforms offer cards, bill pay and wallets to their small-business customers, with AI agents doing underwriting, compliance, fraud and support.
startups.round: $21.9M Series A led by LGVP

startups.name: Firstwork
startups.pitch: AI agents that onboard and support frontline workers: documents, compliance checks and training across existing HR and payroll systems.
startups.round: $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital

startups.name: Pigment
startups.pitch: Business planning platform whose analyst, planner and modeler agents build and run finance plans.
startups.round: $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, led by Scaleup Europe Fund

startups.name: Mave
startups.pitch: AI agents that investigate alerts, hunt threats and run approved responses for enterprise security teams.
startups.round: $34M total: $28M Series A led by Red Dot Capital Partners plus a $6M seed

startups.name: Different
startups.pitch: AI system that runs B2B demand generation end to end for lean marketing teams.
startups.round: $48M seed led by General Catalyst, with Lightspeed

startups.name: Qualitate
startups.pitch: AI-moderated expert interviews and research agents for teams that buy expert-network calls.
startups.round: $25M Series A led by Insight Partners

startups.name: Duvo
startups.pitch: Enterprise Execution OS: staff and agents run governed processes across existing systems, starting with retail and CPG.
startups.round: $32M Series A led by Balderton Capital

startups.name: RapidCanvas
startups.pitch: Builds custom AI apps and agents for mid-size enterprises and runs them in production.
startups.round: $29M Series B led by Vertex Ventures SEA & India

startups.name: Causa Prima
startups.pitch: Agent-to-agent network where buyers' payables agents and suppliers' receivables agents settle disputes and payment terms.
startups.round: $20M seed led by Base10 Partners

startups.name: Clueso
startups.pitch: Agents that operate real software to record, script, narrate and update business videos.
startups.round: $10M Series A led by Dharana Capital

startups.name: Grep AI
startups.pitch: Self-improving agents that move repeated steps from model calls into code, getting cheaper at the same task.

themes.summary: Horizontal platforms learn how a company's work really gets done and let agents carry it out across the systems it already has, from back-office checks to supplier payments.
themes.title: Agents that run company operations

startups.name: Azoma
startups.pitch: Helps brands get their products picked by AI shopping agents; customers include Unilever, L'Oréal and Mars.
startups.round: $11.2M Series A led by Puma Growth Partners

startups.name: Blackwall
startups.pitch: Bot, DDoS and AI-agent traffic management that hosting providers sell to the websites they host.
startups.round: $100M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by AVP

themes.summary: More and more web traffic is AI agents rather than people, so sites need ways to manage that traffic and brands need their products picked when an agent does the shopping.
themes.title: The web reorganizes around AI visitors

startups.name: Crosby
startups.pitch: AI-native law firm where lawyers and agents review and negotiate contracts; has bid for the data, brand and trademark of the collapsing firm Weil Gotshal.
startups.round: $60M Series B led by Lux and Index

startups.name: Midstream Health
startups.pitch: AI agents that find and recover money hospitals are owed or overpay across contracts, pharmacy and supply chain; 250+ hospitals in its customer network.
startups.round: $20M Series A led by Valtruis, with a16z

startups.name: Ravical
startups.pitch: Firm-wide AI for accounting and tax firms that applies senior staff's judgment to every client; used by 100+ firms in Europe.
startups.round: $17M seed led by MMC Ventures

startups.name: Easol
startups.pitch: Booking, payments and marketing platform for festivals and experience businesses (Coachella, Defected) that now ships Teammates agents for sales, support and operations.
startups.round: $30M Series A extension: $20M equity from Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Foundation Capital and others, plus $10M debt

startups.name: TrashLab
startups.pitch: AI-native operating system for waste haulers: dispatch, routing, billing and an order-taking agent.
startups.round: $12M Series A led by Ventana

startups.name: Casap
startups.pitch: AI agents that investigate and resolve card disputes and fraud for 100+ banks, credit unions and fintechs, now moving into collections and claims.
startups.round: $56M Series B led by Base10 Partners, with Experian and Synchrony

startups.name: Broccoli
startups.pitch: AI agents that answer calls for plumbing, HVAC and electrical firms around the clock and book jobs straight into their scheduling software; 500+ customers and over $1B a year in jobs booked (run rate).
startups.round: $52M across a $22M Series A and $30M Series B, led by Khosla Ventures

startups.name: Vera Health
startups.pitch: Clinical AI search engine that finds and grades medical evidence before answering; used by about 800,000 clinicians.
startups.round: $28.5M Series A led by Threshold Ventures

startups.name: Nevis
startups.pitch: AI operating system for wealth-management firms: CRM, meeting notes, planning and custodial paperwork, with agents that finish the work end to end.
startups.round: $70M Series B led by EQT Ventures, with Charles Schwab, QuantumLight, Sequoia, ICONIQ and Ribbit

startups.name: Overwatch
startups.pitch: AI threat intelligence for bank fraud, cyber and merchant-risk teams fighting AI-powered cybercrime.
startups.round: $15M Series A led by Mouro Capital, with Visa Ventures and Capital One Ventures

startups.name: Cognitive Credit
startups.pitch: Verified corporate-credit data plus specialist AI and agentic tools for credit analysts at banks and asset managers.
startups.round: $40M strategic growth investment led by Summit Partners, with ETFS Capital

startups.name: Vocca
startups.pitch: Voice AI that answers patient calls and books, moves and reminds appointments for medical practices; used by 15,000 practitioners.
startups.round: $20M Series A led by Norrsken VC

startups.name: Flai
startups.pitch: Voice AI and agents for car dealerships that answer calls, book service and sales appointments and update dealer systems.
startups.round: $27M Series A led by Base10 Partners

startups.name: Legora
startups.pitch: Agentic operating system for lawyers and in-house legal teams; $200M+ ARR and 140,000+ legal professionals.
startups.round: $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, led by Atreides Management

startups.name: Mach9
startups.pitch: AI CAD software that turns LiDAR and 3D scans into civil-engineering drawings.
startups.round: $34M Series A co-led by First Round and Bessemer

startups.name: Baba
startups.pitch: AI agents plus care teams that act as patient advocates for Medicare and Medicaid members.
startups.round: $40M Series A led by FirstMark

startups.name: Kairos Health
startups.pitch: AI front desk for dental practices: answers calls 24/7, calls overdue patients and verifies insurance.

startups.name: Vesta
startups.pitch: AI-native mortgage loan origination system with agents across lending workflows.
startups.round: $30M led by Conversion Capital

startups.name: Siena AI
startups.pitch: Empathic customer-experience agents for commerce brands.
startups.round: $17M Series A

startups.name: Slingshot Insurance
startups.pitch: AI-native insurer infrastructure for small policies sold at checkout, for platforms, MGAs and capital providers.
startups.round: $27M seed co-led by Rally Ventures and Skyward Group

themes.summary: Law, accounting, hospital finance, waste hauling, events, lending and more are each getting AI-native platforms where professionals and their agents do the core work together. Some now act as the firm itself: AI law firm Crosby is bidding for collapsing Weil Gotshal's data and brand. The largest, Legora, passed $200M ARR.
themes.title: Agents built for one industry

startups.name: DeepSeek
startups.pitch: Chinese open-weight model lab behind the DeepSeek models.
startups.round: About $15B (roughly 100B yuan), backed by Tencent and CATL

startups.name: Nous Research
startups.pitch: Open-model lab behind Hermes, now selling Hermes for Businesses agents.
startups.round: $90M at a $1.5B valuation

startups.name: Manus
startups.pitch: General-purpose autonomous agent that does hands-on work for users and teams.
startups.round: $500M+ after planned Meta acquisition fell through

themes.summary: Open-model labs are raising big rounds and packaging agents for business users.
themes.title: Open models moving into enterprises

title: Startups · Arun Arumugam
